title: Offline-First Quantized AI: Design and Evaluation of an On-Device Maternal-Health Assistant for Low-Connectivity Environments
abstract: arXiv:2611.20012v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Offline language models could extend access to maternal-health information where internet connectivity is unreliable, but deployment requires both clinically appropriate responses and feasible local execution. This study presents an offline Android assistant integrating ready-made quantized language models, a clinically validated local knowledge package, conversational context, and model-initiated local retrieval. Gemma 4 E2B and Qwen3.5 0.8B were compared across 45 conversations and 312 turns per configuration, including a dedicated offline agentic benchmark. Gemma achieved higher response-quality, context-retention, and safety scores; Qwen offered faster generation and lower memory use. Clinician assessment of 150 Gemma responses across nine clinical domains yielded a mean quality score of 3.80/4, with 147 responses meeting the acceptance criterion. A paired RAG-on/off experiment evaluated 74 questions: retrieval improved 11 responses,

translated_title: 离线优先的量化人工智能：面向低网络连接环境的设备端孕产妇健康助手的设计与评估
translated_abstract: 离线语言模型可以在互联网连接不可靠的地区扩大孕产妇健康信息的获取途径，但部署既需要临床上恰当的回复，也需要可行的本地运行。本研究提出了一款离线安卓助手，它集成了现成的量化语言模型、经临床验证的本地知识包、对话上下文以及由模型发起的本地检索。该研究在45次对话、每个配置312轮对话的条件下比较了Gemma 4 E2B与Qwen3.5 0.8B，其中包括一项专门的离线智能体基准测试。Gemma在回复质量、上下文保留和安全性方面获得了更高的评分；而Qwen则具有更快的生成速度和更低的内存占用。临床医生对Gemma在九个临床领域的150条回复进行评估，平均质量得分为3.80/4，其中147条回复达到了接受标准。一项配对的RAG开/关实验评估了74个问题：检索改善了11条回复，（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究设计并评估了一款面向低网络连接环境的离线安卓孕产妇健康助手，通过集成量化语言模型、本地临床知识包与设备端检索，在临床质量、安全性与本地可行性之间实现了有效平衡。
en_tdlr: This study designs and evaluates an offline-first Android maternal-health assistant that integrates quantized language models, a clinically validated local knowledge package, and on-device retrieval, balancing clinical quality, safety, and feasible local execution in low-connectivity environments.
